contexts.title: Grantmaking
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for giving and seeking grants, for any funder (private or community foundation, corporate program, government agency) and any grantee: who funds, what they solicit, the applications that answer, and the awards made and paid.

concepts.definition: An organization that gives money to other organizations or individuals for a public or charitable purpose without buying anything in return: a private or community foundation, corporate giving program, or government agency making grants.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier: a 360Giving org-id (e.g. GB-CHC-…), a Grants.gov agency code, or a tax/registration-based id.

fields.name: organizationType
fields.description: Kind of grantmaker, e.g. private foundation, community foundation, corporate, government agency.

fields.name: registrationNumber
fields.description: Charity, company or tax registration number (UK charity number, US EIN).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Mission or area of work.

fields.name: fundingPriorities
fields.description: Causes or areas the grantmaker says it funds.

fields.name: addressLocality
fields.description: City or town of the organization's address.

fields.name: addressRegion
fields.description: County, state or region of the organization's address.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: 360Giving Organization (fundingOrganization: id, name, organisationType, charityNumber/companyNumber, url, description, addressLocality, addressRegion); Grants.gov search2/fetchOpportunity agency (agencyCode, agency/agencyName); the user's Grant-Researcher Funder (name, baseUrl, mission, fundingPriorities, ProPublica EIN/city/state) and Grant-Collab's shared funder registry (name, URL, focus).

concepts.definition: A published invitation from a grantmaker to apply for grants: what it will fund, who is eligible, the application window and deadline, and the range and total of awards. One grant round or solicitation, not the awards that result from it.
concepts.coRefersRationale: Not the same referent as Tender Notice (https://schemalattice.com/c/public-procurement/tender-notice@b8c9b14895ae): a tender calls for bids to sell goods or services to a government buyer, while this invites proposals for assistance the funder does not consume. Grants.gov itself labels procurement contracts as a separate funding instrument.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: System identifier of the opportunity (e.g. Grants.gov opportunity id).

fields.name: opportunityNumber
fields.description: The funder's own number for the solicitation.

fields.name: funder
fields.description: The grantmaker offering it (grantmaking Funder), by its identifier.

fields.name: openDate
fields.description: When applications open or the notice was posted.

fields.name: closeDate
fields.description: Application deadline; empty for rolling opportunities.

fields.name: awardFloor
fields.description: Smallest award offered.

fields.name: awardCeiling
fields.description: Largest award offered.

fields.name: estimatedTotalFunding
fields.description: Total money available across all awards.

fields.name: applicantEligibility
fields.description: Free-text statement of who may apply.

fields.name: applicantTypes
fields.description: Eligible applicant categories, e.g. 501(c)(3) nonprofits, city governments, individuals (Grants.gov eligibility codes where used).

fields.name: geographicEligibility
fields.description: Where applicants must be based or the work must take place.

fields.name: fundingCategories
fields.description: Topic categories of the funded activity.

fields.name: grantProgrammeCode
fields.description: Code of the funding programme it belongs to (US Assistance Listing/CFDA number on Grants.gov).

fields.name: url
fields.description: Full announcement or application page.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Grants.gov search2 hits and fetchOpportunity synopsis (number, title, agency, posting/response dates, oppStatus, awardFloor/Ceiling, estimatedFunding, applicantEligibilityDesc, applicantTypes, fundingInstruments, fundingActivityCategories, cfdas, fundingDescLinkUrl); the user's Grant-Researcher Opportunity (grantTitle, funderId, summary, deadline, applicantEligibility, applicantTypes, geographicEligibility, applicationUrl), NHSWRA-grants Cycle (name, description, opensAt, closesAt, fundingCents, minCents, maxCents, geography) and Governance-Dance shared grant (title, funder, deadline, summary); 360Giving grantProgramme (code, title).

concepts.definition: A request an organization submits in answer to a solicitation, asking a grantmaker for a stated amount for a described project: the applicant and contact, answers to the funder's questions, budget, planned dates, and where it stands from draft through decision.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Project title.

fields.name: opportunity
fields.description: The solicitation applied to (grantmaking Funding Opportunity).

fields.name: applicantOrganization
fields.description: The applying organization.

fields.name: applicantType
fields.description: Kind of applicant, e.g. nonprofit, school, community group.

fields.name: fiscalSponsor
fields.description: Sponsoring organization when the applicant is not itself eligible.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: budgetLines
fields.description: Itemized budget.

fields.name: responses
fields.description: The funder's questions and the applicant's answers.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: The user's NHSWRA-grants draftSchema/Application (title, organization, organizationType, sponsor, contact, email, phone, requestedCents, budget, answers, startsOn, endsOn, status, submittedAt) and Grant-Researcher GrantDraft/Opportunity (title, opportunityId, questions/answers, amountRequested, submitted/awarded/declined); 360Giving amountAppliedFor, currency, plannedDates, applicationTransaction.transactionDate.

concepts.definition: A grantmaker's decision to give a recipient a set amount, non-repayable, for a stated purpose over a period: who gave, who received, how much was applied for, awarded and paid out, when, and under which programme. The record 360Giving calls a grant.
concepts.coRefersRationale: Not the same referent as public-procurement Contract Award (https://schemalattice.com/c/public-procurement/contract-award@c67c49cbff51): a contract award buys goods or services for the buyer through competitive bidding and the buyer receives what is delivered, while a grant transfers money to a recipient for its own public-benefit purpose with no purchase. Same shape (amount, date, parties), different obligation.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Globally unique grant id (360Giving: publisher prefix plus internal id).

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the money is for.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code.

fields.name: amountDisbursed
fields.description: Paid to date.

fields.name: awardDate
fields.description: When the decision to award was made.

fields.name: fundingOrganization
fields.description: The grantmaker (grantmaking Funder), by identifier.

fields.name: recipientOrganization
fields.description: Receiving organization, by identifier.

fields.name: recipientIndividual
fields.description: Receiving person, when the grant is to an individual.

fields.name: application
fields.description: The application it answers (grantmaking Grant Application).

fields.name: grantProgramme
fields.description: Programme it was made under.

fields.name: fromOpenCall
fields.description: Made through an open call for applications.

fields.name: beneficiaryLocation
fields.description: Where the beneficiaries are.

fields.name: disbursements
fields.description: Payments made under the grant.

fields.name: reportDueDate
fields.description: When the grantee's progress or final report is due.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: 360Giving grant (id, title, description, currency, amountAppliedFor, amountAwarded, amountDisbursed, awardDate, plannedDates, fundingOrganization, recipientOrganization, recipientIndividual, grantProgramme, fromOpenCall, beneficiaryLocation, disbursementTransaction, url); the user's NHSWRA-grants awardSchema (amountCents, initialDate/initialCents, finalDate/finalCents, reportDue) and Grant-Researcher outcome (amountAwarded, outcomeAt, report step dates).

sources.title: 360Giving Data Standard
sources.recordDescription: One grant: who gave how much to which organisation or individual, when, for what, under which programme, with planned dates, beneficiary locations and payment transactions.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: The unique identifier for this grant. Made up of your 360Giving prefix, and an identifier from your records. See the [360Giving Grant identifier guidance](https://standard.threesixtygiving.org/en/latest/technical/identifiers/#grant-identifier) for details.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: A title for this grant activity. This should be under 140 characters long.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: A short description of this grant activity.

fields.name: amountAppliedFor
fields.label: Amount Applied For
fields.description: Total amount applied for in numbers (do not include commas or currency symbols such as £). If you have provided detailed transaction information on a separate table, this should equal the sum of all the application transactions for this grant.

fields.name: amountAwarded
fields.label: Amount Awarded
fields.description: Total amount awarded in numbers (do not include commas or currency symbols such as £). If you have provided detailed transaction information on a separate table, this should equal the sum of all the award transactions for this grant.

fields.name: amountDisbursed
fields.label: Amount Disbursed
fields.description: Total amount disbursed (paid) to this grantee when this record was last updated (in numbers: do not include commas or currency symbols such as £)). If you have provided detailed transaction information on a separate table, this should equal the sum of all the disbursement transactions for this grant.

fields.name: awardDate
fields.label: Award Date
fields.description: When the decision to award this grant was made. The date must be written as YYYY-MM-DD, or in full date-time format.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: A URL (Web Address) where further information about this grant can be found. This could point to the website of the recipient organisation, or might link to further details on the funders website.

fields.name: plannedDates.title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The title of this event

fields.name: plannedDates.startDate
fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: All events should have a start date. Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD or date-time format. If the month or day are not available, these may be omitted.

fields.name: plannedDates.endDate
fields.label: End Date
fields.description: An end date for the grant. Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD or date-time format. If the month or day are not available, these may be omitted.

fields.name: plannedDates.duration
fields.label: Duration (months)
fields.description: The duration of the grant, in months. Must be in number format.

fields.name: plannedDates.description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: A description of this event

fields.name: plannedDates.dateModified
fields.label: Last Modified
fields.description: When was information about this event last modified? A full date-time should be given. Usually this can be generated automatically by the software managing or exporting this data.

fields.description: When did this transaction take place? The date should be written as YYYY-MM-DD, or in full date-time format.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: The total value of this transaction.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.valueDate
fields.label: Value Date
fields.description: The date that this value was set (to allow historical currency conversion). The date should be written as YYYY-MM-DD, or in full date-time format.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: A description of this transaction.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.provider
fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The organisation identifier of the provider of transaction funds.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.recipient
fields.label: Recipient
fields.description: The organisation identifier of the recipient of transaction funds.

fields.name: disbursementTransaction.dateModified
fields.label: Last Modified
fields.description: When was information about this transaction last updated? A full date-time should be given. Usually this can be generated automatically by the software managing or exporting this data.

fields.name: relatedActivity
fields.label: Related Activity
fields.description: The identifiers of any related activities (e.g. other grants given as part of a multi-grant project)

fields.name: dateModified
fields.label: Last Modified
fields.description: When was information on this grant last updated? A full date-time format must be given. Usually this can be generated automatically by the software managing or exporting this data.

fields.name: dataSource
fields.label: Data Source
fields.description: A web link pointing to the source of this data. This may be an original 360Giving data file, a file from which the data was converted, or an organisation website.

fields.name: regrantType
fields.label: For Regrant Type
fields.description: A code referring to the type of regranting process that this grant represents. The value for this field should be drawn from the Regrant Type codelist

fields.name: locationScope
fields.label: Location Scope
fields.description: A code referring to the location scope applicable to this grant. The value for this field should be drawn from the Location Scope codelist.

sources.note: Fields are JSON paths in the 1.4.3 JSON schema (arrays flattened: recipientOrganization.id is the id of each recipient organisation). Used by UK funders publishing to GrantNav; its Organization, Location and Transaction shapes are reused across recipient, funder and payments.

sources.title: Grants.gov opportunity search (search2 API)
sources.publisher: Grants.gov, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.recordDescription: One U.S. federal funding opportunity listing (forecast or synopsis) as returned in search2's oppHits: number, title, agency, open and close dates, status and Assistance Listing numbers.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Grants.gov internal opportunity id (opportunityId in fetchOpportunity).

fields.name: number
fields.description: The agency's funding opportunity number.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Opportunity title (HTML entities encoded).

fields.name: agencyCode
fields.description: Grants.gov agency code of the posting agency, e.g. NSF or DOS-CPV (sub-agency after the hyphen).

fields.name: agency
fields.description: Posting agency name.

fields.name: openDate
fields.description: Posted date, MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.name: closeDate
fields.description: Application close date, MM/DD/YYYY; empty when none is set.

fields.name: oppStatus
fields.description: forecasted, posted, closed or archived.

fields.name: docType
fields.description: synopsis or forecast.

fields.name: cfdaList
fields.description: Assistance Listing (CFDA) numbers the opportunity funds under.

sources.note: POST JSON, no key (e.g. {"rows":25,"keyword":"community","oppStatuses":"posted"}). Fields are each data.oppHits[] item. Verified 2026-10-13: errorcode 0, 417 posted hits for 'community'. Detail per opportunity is grants-gov-fetch-opportunity.

sources.title: Grants.gov opportunity detail (fetchOpportunity API)
sources.publisher: Grants.gov, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.recordDescription: One U.S. federal funding opportunity in full: synopsis, award floor and ceiling, estimated funding, eligible applicant types, funding instrument and category, Assistance Listings and application packages.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Grants.gov internal opportunity id.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Revision number of the opportunity record.

fields.name: opportunityNumber
fields.description: The agency's funding opportunity number.

fields.name: opportunityTitle
fields.description: Opportunity title.

fields.name: owningAgencyCode
fields.description: Agency code of the owning agency.

fields.name: opportunityCategory.category
fields.description: Category code: D discretionary, M mandatory, C continuation, E earmark, O other.

fields.name: opportunityCategory.description
fields.description: Category name.

fields.name: docType
fields.description: synopsis or forecast.

fields.name: ost
fields.description: Opportunity status, e.g. POSTED, FORECASTED, CLOSED, ARCHIVED.

fields.name: synopsis.agencyCode
fields.description: Agency code.

fields.name: synopsis.agencyName
fields.description: Agency name.

fields.name: synopsis.agencyContactName
fields.description: Agency contact name (often an office, sometimes a person).

fields.name: synopsis.agencyContactEmail
fields.description: Agency contact email.

fields.name: synopsis.agencyContactPhone
fields.description: Agency contact phone.

fields.name: synopsis.synopsisDesc
fields.description: Synopsis description (HTML).

fields.name: synopsis.postingDate
fields.description: Posting date, e.g. 'Jun 06, 2025 12:00:00 AM EDT'.

fields.name: synopsis.responseDate
fields.description: Application due date, same format; absent when none.

fields.name: synopsis.archiveDate
fields.description: Date the opportunity is archived.

fields.name: synopsis.costSharing
fields.description: Whether cost sharing or matching is required.

fields.name: synopsis.numberOfAwards
fields.description: Expected number of awards.

fields.name: synopsis.estimatedFunding
fields.description: Estimated total program funding, dollars.

fields.name: synopsis.awardCeiling
fields.description: Largest award, dollars.

fields.name: synopsis.awardFloor
fields.description: Smallest award, dollars.

fields.name: synopsis.applicantEligibilityDesc
fields.description: Additional information on eligibility (free text).

fields.name: synopsis.applicantTypes.id
fields.description: Eligible applicant type codes (00 state governments … 12 501(c)(3) nonprofits … 99 unrestricted).

fields.name: synopsis.applicantTypes.description
fields.description: Eligible applicant type names.

fields.name: synopsis.fundingInstruments.id
fields.description: Funding instrument codes: G grant, CA cooperative agreement, PC procurement contract, O other.

fields.name: synopsis.fundingInstruments.description
fields.description: Funding instrument names.

fields.name: synopsis.fundingActivityCategories.id
fields.description: Category of funding activity codes, e.g. CD community development, ED education.

fields.name: synopsis.fundingActivityCategories.description
fields.description: Category of funding activity names.

fields.name: synopsis.fundingDescLinkUrl
fields.description: Link to the full announcement.

fields.name: synopsis.lastUpdatedDate
fields.description: When the synopsis was last updated.

fields.name: topAgencyDetails.agencyCode
fields.description: Top-level (department) agency code.

fields.name: topAgencyDetails.agencyName
fields.description: Top-level (department) agency name.

fields.name: cfdas.cfdaNumber
fields.description: Assistance Listing (CFDA) number.

fields.name: cfdas.programTitle
fields.description: Assistance Listing program title.

fields.name: opportunityPkgs.packageId
fields.description: Application package id.

fields.name: opportunityPkgs.openingDate
fields.description: Application package opening date, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: opportunityPkgs.closingDate
fields.description: Application package closing date, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: opportunityPkgs.expectedApplicationCount
fields.description: Applications the agency expects to receive.

sources.note: POST JSON {"opportunityId": <search2 id>}, no key. Fields are paths under data (arrays flattened, history and attachment arrays omitted). Verified 2026-10-13 against opportunity 359325.

fields.conversion: UK charity number; companyNumber when there is none
MM/DD/YYYY → YYYY-MM-DD; empty means no deadline set
'Mon DD, YYYY hh:mm:ss AM TZ' → date
